description: This file defines the 'ModelField' class, which models the attributes of a data field in a data processing or data modeling context within the Ofbiz framework. It includes fields for properties such as name, position, length, type, format, validation, default value, and flags for primary key, ignored status, and expression source.

classes.name: ModelField
classes.description: A data class representing a field in a data model, with properties such as name, type, position, length, and various flags.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the field.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of the field in the record.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the field in the record.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the field in bytes.

methods.name: setLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the field in bytes.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the field.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of the field.

methods.name: setFormat
methods.description: Sets the format of the field.

methods.name: setValidExp
methods.description: Sets the validation expression for the field.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the field.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for the field.

methods.name: setPk
methods.description: Marks the field as a primary key.

methods.name: setIgnored
methods.description: Marks the field as ignored.

methods.name: setExpression
methods.description: Marks the field as sourced from an input expression.

methods.name: setRefField
methods.description: Sets the referenced field name.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value of the field.

methods.name: isExpression
methods.description: Returns whether the field is derived from an expression.

methods.name: getRefField
methods.description: Returns the referenced field name.

methods.name: isIgnored
methods.description: Returns whether the field is ignored.
